page_title: NEW 1-2 BOU | Newcastle v Bournemouth 18/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Newcastle enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
90+5' The attendance for today's match is 52109.
90+4' Thomas Bramall has issued a yellow card to Djordje Petrovic (Bournemouth).
90+4' Good work from Newcastle as they win a corner.

90+3' Great save! Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Djordje Petrovic. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Newcastle.
90+2' Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90+1' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) commits a foul during an attacking move.
90' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Here comes a substitution. Alex Toth (Bournemouth) is brought on as a substitute for Marcus Tavernier.
89' Andoni Iraola prepares a substitution. Evanilson is replaced by Enes Unal (Bournemouth).
86' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Sandro Tonali as he is replaced by Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd).
85' Goal! Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 1:2.
82' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Thomas Bramall ignores the protests.
80' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd).
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rayan leaves the pitch and Ben Doak (Bournemouth) comes on.
77' Today's referee Thomas Bramall rightly decides to book Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd) for his harsh tackle.
74' Eddie Howe is forced to make a change. Valentino Livramento is unable to continue due to injury, Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) comes on.
71' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Thomas Bramall signals that the goal stands! The Newcastle players celebrate.
69' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Newcastle players aren’t happy.
68' 1 - 1 Goal! William Osula (Newcastle Utd) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:1.
66' That's the end of the game for Eli Junior Kroupi, who is replaced by David Brooks (Bournemouth).
65' Substitution. Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) has come on for Ryan Christie.
62' Here is a change. Jacob Ramsey is going off and Eddie Howe gives the last tactical orders to Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd).
62' Anthony Elanga comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd).

61' What a poor attempt! Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
60' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
57' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
56' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Djordje Petrovic intercepts the ball.
55' The main referee, Thomas Bramall, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is given a yellow card for dissent.
52' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Thomas Bramall didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
51' Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
51' The Newcastle players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
50' A cross from Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
49' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
47' A cross by Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
46' Here's the change. Lewis Hall leaves the pitch and Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) comes on as a substitute.
46' Referee Thomas Bramall blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Newcastle.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.

45' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
43' It seemed like Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
41' Evanilson (Bournemouth) tries to find Marcus Tavernier, but he puts too much power on the pass.
40' Rayan (Bournemouth) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
38' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 3:7.
38' Great teamplay by Newcastle as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
34' The Bournemouth players are exchanging some short passes.
32' 0 - 1 Goal! A great through ball by Rayan sets up Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball low into the middle of the goal. 0:1.
31' Aaron Ramsdale (Newcastle Utd) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.

28' What a chance that is! Rayan (Bournemouth) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
27' Newcastle control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
25' Newcastle are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
21' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
21' The Bournemouth players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

20' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Thomas Bramall with no other option than to blow for a foul.
19' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
16' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) will deliver the corner kick.
15' Corner kick. Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) is ready to send the ball into the box.
15' Newcastle seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
14' Bournemouth seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
12' Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) takes a good touch to control a cross on the edge of the box and shoots towards the left post, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block his effort.

6' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
5' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) releases William Osula, who latched on to his perfect through pass and can continue with his team's attack.
3' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
2' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
1' The game is pretty dull as Bournemouth are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Bournemouth will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Thomas Bramall.
